scripts.posttest: npm run preallure:generate && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.preallure:generate: shx mkdir -p allure-results/history && shx cp -r allure-report/history/* allure-results/history || true
scripts.perf:bundle:smoke: shx mkdir -p k6-dist k6-results && esbuild performance/scenarios/todos.smoke.ts --bundle --outfile=k6-dist/smoke.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:k6*
scripts.perf:bundle:load: shx mkdir -p k6-dist k6-results && esbuild performance/scenarios/todos.load.ts --bundle --outfile=k6-dist/load.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:k6*
scripts.perf:bundle:stress: shx mkdir -p k6-dist k6-results && esbuild performance/scenarios/todos.stress.ts --bundle --outfile=k6-dist/stress.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:k6*
scripts.perf:bundle:spike: shx mkdir -p k6-dist k6-results && esbuild performance/scenarios/todos.spike.ts --bundle --outfile=k6-dist/spike.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:k6*
scripts.perf:smoke: npm run perf:bundle:smoke && k6 run --out json=k6-results/smoke.json k6-dist/smoke.js
scripts.perf:load: npm run perf:bundle:load && k6 run --out json=k6-results/load.json k6-dist/load.js
scripts.perf:stress: npm run perf:bundle:stress && k6 run --out json=k6-results/stress.json k6-dist/stress.js
scripts.perf:spike: npm run perf:bundle:spike && k6 run --out json=k6-results/spike.json k6-dist/spike.js
